scope: Expert Mission 16/18/19/20 skill provenance and reward identity

records.name: Super Spirit Bomb
evidence: Repository EM16 evidence identifies Super Spirit Bomb with Expert Mission 16 — In the Realm of the Gods: Vegeta.
The maintained independent all-Expert-Missions guide lists Super Spirit Bomb as the EM16 Basic Reward.
Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies Super Spirit Bomb as a Ki Blast Ultimate and records a 300 Ki cost.

promoted_fields.mission_title: In the Realm of the Gods: Vegeta

limits: No numerical drop probability or first-clear guarantee is inferred.
Historical timer/regeneration behavior remains version-sensitive and is not promoted here.

records.name: Focus Flash
evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies Expert Mission 18 — The Ultimate Evil: Broly! as the unlock endpoint.
The maintained independent all-Expert-Missions guide lists Focus Flash as the EM18 Basic Reward.

Current skill documentation identifies Focus Flash as a 100 Ki Ki Blast Super; its documented behavior is an initial energy sphere followed by a rapid Ki Blast barrage if the first projectile connects, and it can be used during a Boost Dash.
limits: No numerical drop probability or first-clear guarantee is inferred.
Detailed frame data, exact tracking values, and version-sensitive damage are not promoted.

records.name: Tail Slicer
evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies Expert Mission 19 — A Truly Hellish Transformation as the acquisition endpoint.
The maintained independent all-Expert-Missions guide lists Tail Slicer as the EM19 Basic Reward.
Current skill documentation identifies Tail Slicer as a 100 Ki Ki Blast Super with a sideways-moving disc projectile and directional movement input.
limits: No numerical drop probability or first-clear guarantee is inferred.
The post-update history is retained as provenance context, not as a claim about every current platform/version build.

records.name: Data Input
evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies Expert Mission 20 — Harbinger of Doom as the unlock endpoint.
The maintained independent all-Expert-Missions guide lists Data Input as the EM20 Basic Reward.

Current skill documentation identifies Data Input as a 100 Ki Power Up Super with a 20-second duration and Auto Dodge against melee attacks while the user makes no inputs; the buff can be interrupted by other hitstun.
Dragon Ball reference material identifies the Xenoverse 2 implementation as an Extra Pack 1 skill used by Android 13.
limits: No numerical drop probability or first-clear guarantee is inferred.
Exact activation frames, hitbox behavior, and version-sensitive mechanics are not promoted.

validation.scope_note: EM17 Spirit Sword remains separately reconciled because the independent guide labels its EM17 Basic Reward as Spirit Bomb; this batch does not merge or overwrite that conflict.

evidence_boundary: Batch 332 strengthens the four deterministic EM16/18/19/20 skill endpoints and selected current skill mechanics while preserving the repository's research-only boundary. EM17 Spirit Sword is intentionally excluded from this batch's promotion because its source conflict remains a separate evidence boundary.
